title: Gratifying Experience
text:
My wife and I went to Khalma Massage.
It was a very gratifying experience.
Very cozy place and relaxing environment.
Jesus make us feel at home.
We have taken massages on cruises and this doesn’t compare at all.
He is truly a professional.

author: Antonio_U

title: Fantastic Massage
text:
Jésus, the massage therapist, was very calm and professional. I had a full body deep tissue massage where he worked very hard at removing the knots from my neck and shoulder area. Lots of soft tissue release therapy was used and mobilisation of shoulders and hips.
It was a full one hour session and very good value for money. I felt like a new woman at the end of the session. Thank you Jésus!

title: Thorough Massage
text: Great full body massage, I felt much more mobile afterwards. Would recommend. We used city sightseeing bus to get there as it's a little way from the centre. Bus stop 10.
